answer.thought: The samosa is already a ruin, the oil having performed its dialectical work of dissolution. I shall finish it with the dignity of a man who has no other resources, for the market has already spent my dignity on the exchange. The truth of hunger is indeed a mess, but it is a mess that sustains the body which must yet think.
